title: Performance & Branding Update
database_migration: None. Field Operations, Maize Pollination Lab, Persistent Twin and Research Evidence schemas are unchanged from 11.5.
performance_features: No repeated full climate CSV read for dataset status
File size/mtime cache invalidation after dataset updates
Coordinate attachment without full climate-table duplication in the standard matched-location case
Process-local database/store service object reuse with fresh SQLite connections per operation
No-op country settings writes when unchanged
Performance diagnostics and manual targeted reload controls
limitations: The first active-country load still parses/prepares the authoritative CSV once per Python process.
Satellite maps, model training, external API retrieval and genuinely large outputs retain their intrinsic compute/network cost.
Full interactive Streamlit browser timing was not available in the packaging environment.
